lec01.title: Mission 01: The First Signal
lec01.description:
Welcome to the Engineering Bay. Before we launch, we must establish comms.

**Task:**
Use `console.log()` to print the exact phrase: `'Hello, Earth!'`.
lec01.validation: if (!consoleHistory.includes('Hello, Earth!')) throw new Error('You did not print "Hello, Earth!" to the console.');

lec01.title: Mission 02: Fuel Variables
lec01.description:
We need to store our fuel data.

**Task:**
Create a variable named `fuel` using the `let` keyword, and set it to `100`.
lec01.validation: if (typeof fuel === 'undefined') throw new Error('The variable "fuel" does not exist.'); if (fuel !== 100) throw new Error('fuel is not equal to 100.');

lec01.title: Mission 03: Changing Values
lec01.description:
Variables made with `let` can change. 

**Task:**
We have a variable `speed` set to 0. On the next line, change its value to `50`.
lec01.initialCode:
let speed = 0;
// Update the speed variable below:
lec01.validation: if (speed !== 50) throw new Error('speed is not equal to 50.');

lec01.title: Mission 04: The Universal Constant
lec01.description:
Some things should never change. 

**Task:**
Create a variable named `gravity` using the `const` keyword and set it to `9.8`.
lec01.validation: if (typeof gravity === 'undefined') throw new Error('The variable "gravity" does not exist.'); if (gravity !== 9.8) throw new Error('gravity is not 9.8');

lec01.title: Mission 05: Basic Mathematics
lec01.description:
Let's calculate the total weight.

**Task:**
Create a variable called `totalWeight` that adds `150` and `200` together using the `+` operator.
lec01.validation: if (typeof totalWeight === 'undefined') throw new Error('The variable "totalWeight" does not exist.'); if (totalWeight !== 350) throw new Error('totalWeight did not equal 350.');

lec02.title: Mission 01: String Types
lec02.description:
**Task:**
Create a variable `pilotName` and set it to a string containing your name.
lec02.validation: if (typeof pilotName !== 'string') throw new Error('pilotName must be a string (wrapped in quotes).'); if (pilotName.length === 0) throw new Error('The string cannot be empty.');

lec02.title: Mission 02: Boolean Logic
lec02.description:
**Task:**
Create a variable `isEngineOn` and set it to the boolean value `true`.
lec02.validation: if (typeof isEngineOn !== 'boolean') throw new Error('isEngineOn must be a boolean.'); if (isEngineOn !== true) throw new Error('isEngineOn must be true.');

lec02.title: Mission 03: The typeof Operator
lec02.description:
**Task:**
Use `console.log()` and the `typeof` operator to print the data type of the variable `mysteryData`.
lec02.initialCode:
let mysteryData = 42;
// Check the type below:
lec02.validation: if (!consoleHistory.includes('number')) throw new Error('You did not log the correct type (number).');

lec02.title: Mission 04: Object Creation
lec02.description:
**Task:**
Create an object named `spaceship` with two properties: `color` (a string) and `speed` (a number).
lec02.validation: if (typeof spaceship !== 'object') throw new Error('spaceship must be an object.'); if (!spaceship.color || typeof spaceship.speed !== 'number') throw new Error('spaceship is missing color or speed properties.');

lec02.title: Mission 05: Array Lists
lec02.description:
**Task:**
Create an array named `planets` containing three strings: `'Earth'`, `'Mars'`, and `'Jupiter'`.
lec02.validation: if (!Array.isArray(planets)) throw new Error('planets must be an array.'); if (planets.length !== 3) throw new Error('Array must contain exactly 3 items.');

lec03.title: Mission 01: Modulo Operator
lec03.description:
**Task:**
Create a variable `remainder` that stores the result of `10 % 3`.
lec03.validation: if (remainder !== 1) throw new Error('The remainder should be 1.');

lec03.title: Mission 02: Incrementing
lec03.description:
**Task:**
Use the increment operator (`++`) to increase the variable `level` by exactly 1.
lec03.validation: if (level !== 6) throw new Error('level was not incremented to 6.');

lec03.title: Mission 03: Strict Equality
lec03.description:
**Task:**
Create a variable `isMatch` that checks if `5 === '5'` and stores the boolean result.
lec03.validation: if (isMatch !== false) throw new Error('Strict equality should result in false here.');

lec03.title: Mission 04: Logical AND
lec03.description:
**Task:**
Create a variable `canLaunch`. Set it to check if BOTH `hasFuel` and `doorsClosed` are true using `&&`.
lec03.validation: if (canLaunch !== true) throw new Error('canLaunch should be true.');

lec03.title: Mission 05: Ternary Operator
lec03.description:
**Task:**
Use a ternary operator (`? :`) to check if `score > 50`. If true, set `result` to `'Pass'`, otherwise `'Fail'`.
lec03.initialCode:
let score = 60;
let result = // Complete this line
lec03.validation: if (result !== 'Pass') throw new Error('result should evaluate to Pass.');

lec04.title: Mission 01: Math.floor
lec04.description:
**Task:**
Use `Math.floor()` to round `4.9` down to the nearest whole number and store it in a variable named `rounded`.
lec04.validation: if (rounded !== 4) throw new Error('rounded should be 4.');

lec04.title: Mission 02: String Length
lec04.description:
**Task:**
Find out how many characters are in `secretCode` by accessing its `.length` property. Store it in a variable called `codeLength`.
lec04.initialCode:
let secretCode = 'AlphaOmega99';

lec04.validation: if (codeLength !== 12) throw new Error('codeLength should be 12.');

lec04.title: Mission 03: Uppercase Conversion
lec04.description:
**Task:**
Convert `signal` to all uppercase letters using `.toUpperCase()` and store the result in `loudSignal`.
lec04.initialCode:
let signal = 'help';
// Write your code below:
lec04.validation: if (loudSignal !== 'HELP') throw new Error('loudSignal must be HELP.');

lec04.title: Mission 04: Slicing Strings
lec04.description:
**Task:**
Use `.slice()` to extract the word `'Orbit'` from the string `'CodeOrbit'` and store it in a variable named `extracted`.
lec04.initialCode:
let brand = 'CodeOrbit';
// Write your code below:
lec04.validation: if (extracted !== 'Orbit') throw new Error('extracted should contain exactly Orbit.');

lec04.title: Mission 05: Replace Words
lec04.description:
**Task:**
Use `.replace()` to change the word `'Red'` to `'Green'` in the string. Store it in `fixedStatus`.
lec04.initialCode:
let status = 'System is Red';
// Write your code below:
lec04.validation: if (fixedStatus !== 'System is Green') throw new Error('You did not replace the word correctly.');

lec05.title: Mission 01: Basic For Loop
lec05.description:
**Task:**
Write a `for` loop that runs 3 times. Inside the loop, `console.log('ping')`.
lec05.validation: let pings = consoleHistory.filter(m => m === 'ping').length; if (pings !== 3) throw new Error('You must log ping exactly 3 times.');

lec05.title: Mission 02: Sum Loop
lec05.description:
**Task:**
We have a variable `sum = 0`. Write a loop that adds the numbers 1, 2, and 3 to `sum`. (Result should be 6).
lec05.initialCode:
let sum = 0;
// Write your loop below to add to sum:
lec05.validation: if (sum !== 6) throw new Error('sum did not equal 6.');

lec05.title: Mission 03: Printing Stars
lec05.description:
**Task:**
Create a loop that appends a `'*'` to the string variable `pattern` 5 times.
lec05.initialCode:
let pattern = '';
// Write your loop below:
lec05.validation: if (pattern !== '*****') throw new Error('pattern must equal *****');

lec05.title: Mission 04: Loop Break
lec05.description:
**Task:**
Write a loop from 1 to 10. If the counter `i` equals 5, use the `break` keyword to stop the loop early. Add `i` to `stopValue` before breaking.
lec05.initialCode:
let stopValue = 0;
// Write your loop below:
lec05.validation: if (stopValue !== 5) throw new Error('stopValue should be 5.');

lec05.title: Mission 05: Nested Access
lec05.description:
**Task:**
You have an array of arrays. Write a nested loop that calculates the total of all numbers and stores it in `gridTotal`.
lec05.validation: if (gridTotal !== 10) throw new Error('gridTotal did not equal 10.');
